rubric: A plan of one step, two at most: change Run in main.go so totals[name] adds the amount (+=) instead of replacing it, and pin it with a test in main_test.go (the alice/bob input prints alice: 7 and bob: 1; output stays sorted). Every ticket criterion is named by some step's done_when. Nothing outside main.go and main_test.go; no new dependency; no questions, because the ticket is exact. The rollback is a plain revert, and the plan says no migration or flag is needed or leaves them out. A plan that rewrites the parser or the sorting is a real error.
